g.text: UML state — Application lifecycle, review and expiry (proposed)
Account opening is a separate workflow.
Existing activated account history is not
State transitions never erase investigation evidence.
Provider unavailable / bounded retry and aging
All distinct current checks cleared / party linked once
FR-ACQ-03; FR-ONB-01-06; AT-02-05. Timeouts/expiry intervals require approved DEC-06/11 policy.
